headline: Eight new skills — calendar scheduling, contract review, intro drafting, decision memos, board packs, and more.

items.prompt_template: I gained eight new skills that all build on your accumulated memory. (1) Calendar scheduling — I can write to your calendar now, with context-aware agendas pulling open commitments. (2) Contract review — parse contracts, compare against your standards, flag deviations, suggest redlines, history-aware. (3) Automation scaffolding — pair with the automation scanner to get a real working Zapier zap, Python script, or n8n flow for the opportunities I surface. (4) Decision revisiting — find decisions worth re-examining based on time elapsed and contradictory new signal. (5) Thread resurrection — find specific quiet conversations worth reviving (different from the dormant-customer scan, which finds quiet people). (6) Intro brokering — draft both-sided intros voice-calibrated to your past ones, with a follow-up check a month out. (7) Decision memos — structured tradeoff analysis with weighted criteria and a recommended call. (8) Board pack assembly — a multi-page board pack that writes itself from your activity history, decision log, people / project memory, and QuickBooks. Try them by name: `build the board pack for next Tuesday`, `review this contract`, `intro Bo to Rio`, `what decisions should I revisit`, and more.
